name: callrec
description: Mac meeting recorder: system audio + mic, live transcript, folder per meeting.

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: callrec records your microphone so your side of the meeting is transcribed and saved.
extendInfo.NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription: callrec records system audio so the other side of the meeting is transcribed and saved.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: callrec transcribes meeting audio on this Mac.
